title: Enrollment proof — Espaço Prelúdio

intro.lead: To unlock the (free) student plan, we need to confirm that you are in the final year of Psychology or Medicine, doing clinical practice or internship. Upload the declaration issued by your institution — our system reads it automatically and unlocks access in seconds. If anything needs human review, we'll email you within 48h.

dropzone.title: Click to choose or drag the file here
dropzone.hint: PDF, PNG or JPG · up to 5 MB

loading.title: Validating document…
loading.hint: We're reading your declaration with AI. It may take 10–30 seconds.

review.lead: Some details need to be reviewed by a human before approval. We'll email you within 48h. You can close this page.

privacyHtml: Privacy: your proof is stored encrypted, accessible only by the Espaço Prelúdio verification team. It is automatically discarded 90 days after validation.
